title: Virtual Photons in Chiral Perturbation Theory
author: Res Urech
version: v2, 1994-06-27 09:52:55 UTC; v1 withdrawn, so only v2 used
hypotheses: Leading mesonic chiral EFT with virtual electromagnetism; source uses SU3 and charges including e. Our SU2 retained light-field restriction uses Q=diag(2/3,-1/3) and writes e4^2 explicitly; its coefficient C is independently matched in the two-flavor theory, not equated numerically with an SU3 fit.
translation: Source Minkowski term +C Tr(Q U Q Udagger), with e inside Q, becomes Euclidean -e4^2 C Tr(Q U Q Udagger). We explicitly subtract its U=1 constant to obtain nonnegative e4^2 C(a1^2+a2^2). Expansion gives Delta M_charged^2=2e4^2 C/F^2, matching the source normalization. Unknown mass/theta-independent normalization and the removed vacuum constant remain explicit.
checks: Primary metadata and exact nonwithdrawn version authenticated

verdict: Verified for the leading local Dashen operator and its charged-pion mass normalization. This source does not prove the new disk integral, any full curved-space QCD+QED partition function, or an alpha-dependent cosmological coefficient.
limits: Independent alpha dependence of Sigma,F,C and higher operators omitted at this insertion order
Mass/theta Ward relation applies to this retained action, not all QCD+QED
